nodes.bogdan_miecz.text.t: Bogdan walked here from Głuszec on foot, because he was ashamed to wait for a cart. He holds the shard in his tongs and eyes it like a man who owes him money. "This metal doesn't get on with iron, but they'll come to terms." He hammers all night, and towards morning hands you a blade that looks more like a neighbour who doesn't say much.

nodes.bogdan_wlocznie.text.t: Bogdan walked here from Głuszec on foot, because he was ashamed to wait for a cart. He splits the shard into two even heads, like cutting bread for twins. "Two hands, two stings. Don't let them quarrel." At dawn he hands you a pair that sits in your hands as if it had been left there.

nodes.brygida_miecz.text.t: Brygida forges it without fuss and without Bogdan, because nobody came from Głuszec. At her own cost and without grumbling. The blade comes out crooked, but it's star metal. "You won't thank me, it won't be pretty anyway," she says, wiping her hands on her apron.

nodes.brygida_wlocznie.text.t: Brygida forges without Bogdan, at her own cost and in a hurry. Two uneven heads from the sky, ugly as sin and just as effective. "They'll stab. Pretty they won't be." For the first time you see her very nearly smile.

nodes.kuznia.options.[zar].text.t: I'll wait for the coals to settle.

nodes.kuznia.text.t: The fire in the forge below Starwatch roars. The shard you took from the hollow lies on the anvil and smells of cold. Someone has to take it up in the tongs.

nodes.po.text.t: The forge cools. The blade weighs less than you expected. The capital is far off, but there's only one road.
